crossRefs.note: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
translations.bsb: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger and did not eat any food that second day of the month, for he was grieved by his father’s shameful treatment of David.
translations.kjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
translations.asv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
